examples.pie: wíHrōs dukté wíHrōs stundté. nu kʷékʷlos wéndʰetor kʷékʷlos pró h₁éyti. nu ḱḗr stuh₂róm mē sth₂éh₁yete.
examples.en: Pull, men, push, men! The wheel turns, the wagon goes forward. The heart is strong, do not stand still!

examples.pie: h₂énh₁mos h₂wḗh₁ti. h₁yód stuh₂rós h₂énh₁mos h₂wḗh₁ti nébʰesh₂ bʰéwgt. h₁yód h₂énh₁mos légʰt léymō ḱéyor. h₂énh₁mosyo wṓkʷs méǵh₂ih₂. h₂énh₁mos n̥bʰrós-kʷe bʰréh₂terh₁e.
examples.en: The wind blows. When a strong wind blows, the clouds flee. When the wind lies down, the lake lies flat. The voice of the wind is great. Wind and rain-cloud are brothers.

examples.pie: h₁yód n̥bʰrós h₁r̥sḱéti stéh₂dʰh₁om gʷowsth₂óm wédʰe. h₁yód nébʰos kl̥Héni sédyeti súHn̥s pérwr̥ mē h₂éǵes. h₁yód stuh₂rós h₂énh₁mos h₂wḗh₁ti suHnúm ḱóymom wédʰe. h₁yód pérkʷunos bʰéh₂ti h₂Hséh₂i sddʰí.
examples.en: When a rain-cloud arrives, lead the herd to the cow-stall. When a cloud sits on the hill, do not drive the pigs to the mountain. When a strong wind blows, lead the son home. When Perkwunos speaks, sit at the hearth.
